sourceDecision: Retain production. The nested labels are Search mounts in this API page and Search paths in this API page. Mount input value is mountSearch with onChange event => setMountSearch(event.target.value); path input value is search with onChange event => setSearch(event.target.value), plus ref={searchInput}. Neither input declares type; no input type default is qualified here. Both search states initialize to the empty string within a shared declaration; collection cursor states initialize to empty arrays separately. Neither inspected onChange declares a cursor setter/reset, normalization, request call or navigation. These literal callbacks do not establish typing, mounted state transitions, focus, requests or actual AT. Saved metadata-announcements injects search slots with forbidden setters; metadata-success supplies synthetic draft search slots and setter machinery, with reviewed targeted cases concerning other public metadata presentation. Targeted searches of these two saved sources found no onChange or exact search-label assertions. They do not qualify actual input events. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations was established.
